mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% annualized over the previous 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL annualized increase > 2.5% does not lead to tighter monetary policy within the next 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% over the previous 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or UNRATE decrease > 0.5% does not correlate with improved corporate earnings within the next 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% over the previous 3 months signals increased economic activity and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or HOUST increase > 5% does not correlate with increased economic activity within the next 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the previous 3 months signals increased supply-side activity, which boosts economic growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO increase > 1% does not correlate with economic growth within the next 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the previous 3 months signals an easing monetary policy, which reduces borrowing costs and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances despite the easing signal, or FEDFUNDS decrease does not lead to reduced borrowing costs within the next 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over the previous month signals strong labor market conditions, which boosts consumer spending and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or PAYEMS increase > 200,000 does not correlate with increased consumer spending within the next month.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) increase by more than 1% and industrial production (INDPRO) decreases by more than 1% over the previous 3 months, it signals a shift from investment to consumption, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increase > 1% and INDPRO decrease > 1% in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the specified conditions do not lead to a shift from investment to consumption within the next 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 3% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4%, it signals a tight monetary policy in a strong labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: tight monetary policy in strong labor market
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the specified conditions do not lead to negative returns within the next 3 months.
